page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.60xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance engineered for large-scale enterprise workloads that demand substantial volatile memory capacity alongside extensive parallel processing capabilities. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture, this instance features 240 dedicated vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon 8490H processors running at a base clock frequency of 1.9 GHz. It includes 4096.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 17.07 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not bundle any local storage or integrated hardware GPU accelerators, delegating data persistence entirely to attached network block storage solutions. High-throughput communication and distributed system integration are facilitated by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which reflects its typical placement within isolated, backend virtual private cloud topologies.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the provision of over 4 TB of RAM in a single compute node eliminates data serialization overheads common in distributed clusters. The trade-off centers on the complete absence of local non-volatile storage, requiring reliance on remote storage volumes for initial data ingestion and persistent checkpoints. Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.60xlarge is suited for in-memory databases like SAP HANA, extensive Redis deployments, massive in-memory analytics engines, and large-scale enterprise resource planning platforms.
